name: Ichijiku
source:
Affiliation: The Corporation
Bug: Spider
Ability: Retainers - Cluster. Ichijiku excels at puppeteering different lifeforms, humans and animals alike through the use of her web while also making use of their senses, making the villagers and small animals an effective network of spies and cannon fodder. However, the ability's limiting factor is being unable to put opponents stronger than herself under the influence. As secondary abilities of her web Ichijiku also camouflages herself and is able to direct long-range voice communications between other members of her group.

The second support-oriented member of the Corporation along with Nijoukubo, Ichijiku has known Sanbara for a long time and considers it an honor to serve her. Due to awakening to her Spider in a very young age, Ichijiku learned to use her web to get around instead of regular human functions like walking or talking, meaning she prefers to hang from the ceiling and uses her web to imitate talking.
